thread:
marie: Planning a pen-test retest handoff. Need ~90m RBAC change window + KMS grant for assessor. Who owns evidence scrub and upload? @josh @samir?

josh: I can own RBAC window. Doing ephemeral role swap at 22:00 UTC. Need list of roles/service principals to change. Assessor creds TTL ok at 1h?

marie: 1h TTL and hard revoke after window. We'll add it to the runbook.

alex: For KMS: will create a short-lived grant via KMS proxy scoped to assessor principal, TTL 1h. I'll revoke grant when done (not rotate key).

samir: I'll handle log sampling & redaction. Plan: sample 1% of requests around the window, run a redact pass (emails/SSNs/cards -> [REDACTED]), produce scrubbed.json and a sha256 manifest of the archive.

anna: I'll create presigned upload link and permissions.

infra-team: Approved to create ephemeral roles in prod namespace. Recommend a quick smoke test after swap to validate gating.

security-oncall: We'll apply alert suppression for known noise during the window and ensure grant revocation is automated.

marie: Final owners: RBAC=josh, KMS grant=alex, scrub=samir, upload=anna, alerts/security=security-oncall. No blockers; proceeding with runbook steps. Thanks!
